10 Best Hotels on the
Chao Phraya Riverside

heroSub: We reviewed each of these 10 riverside hotels in depth. From Mandarin Oriental — Bangkok's 150-year legend at score 9.5 — to AVANI+ Riverside with over 9,000 real guest reviews and a floor-25 infinity pool, down to Ramada Plaza Menam from ฿2,100 with 285 metres of genuine river frontage. Every entry has a real guest score, honest takeaways, and prices compared across three booking platforms.
heroStats: 🚢 All hotels have free ferry shuttles to BTS/ICONSIAM (Shangri-La 270m walk)
introH2: What kind of hotels does the Chao Phraya Riverside offer — and how do you choose?
introHtml: The Chao Phraya is Bangkok's backbone — riverside hotels that earn their place deliver genuine river views, complimentary ferry shuttles to the BTS and ICONSIAM, and an atmosphere you simply can't find inland. This guide covers 10 hotels we have reviewed in depth, each with a real guest score, honest pros and cons, and prices compared across Agoda, Trip.com and Booking.com. From the 150-year Mandarin Oriental legend to a ฿2,100 budget pick with 285 metres of river frontage, there's a genuine fit for every trip.
mrtHtml: Riverside hotels are split across both banks. East-bank properties (Bang Rak, Si Phraya) are closest to BTS Saphan Taksin — Shangri-La Bangkok is just 270m on foot. West-bank hotels (Thon Buri, Khlong San) — Peninsula, Millennium Hilton, Chatrium, Anantara, AVANI+ — all run complimentary ferries to BTS Saphan Taksin and ICONSIAM throughout the day. Every hotel in this guide is connected to BTS either by walking or a hotel ferry.

entries.storyHtml: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok opened in 1876 and is the oldest hotel in Bangkok — its score of 9.5 from 261 real guest reviews is the highest in this entire set. Joseph Conrad, Somerset Maugham and Graham Greene all stayed here, lending their names to the legendary Authors' Wing. Sala Rim Naam riverside Thai restaurant and Le Normandie French fine dining (operating nearly 70 years) are the reasons guests return even at this price point. Note: rooms in the original Authors' Wing run smaller than you might expect at this rate — request a River Wing room if space matters.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Reserve Sala Rim Naam at least 2–3 weeks ahead during high season (Nov–Feb). Take the hotel's cross-river ferry to explore the riverside market on the east bank.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions About Chao Phraya Riverside Hotels Bangkok

faq.q: Which Chao Phraya riverside hotel is closest to the BTS Skytrain?
faq.a: Shangri-La Bangkok wins outright — BTS Saphan Taksin is just 270 metres on foot, no ferry needed. Mandarin Oriental and Royal Orchid Sheraton are in the Si Phraya–Bang Rak area with hotel ferries to the BTS in 5–10 minutes. All west-bank hotels (Peninsula, Chatrium, Millennium Hilton, Anantara, AVANI+) run complimentary ferries to BTS Saphan Taksin throughout the day.

faq.q: Which riverside hotel guarantees a river view from every room?
faq.a: The Peninsula Bangkok is the clearest guarantee — all 348 rooms face the Chao Phraya by design (W-Wing architecture). Royal Orchid Sheraton Bangkok is the other exception, with all 726 rooms river-facing via its twin curved-tower design. At other hotels in this guide, you need to select a River View room category specifically to guarantee the view.

faq.q: Which riverside hotel is closest to ICONSIAM?
faq.a: Millennium Hilton Bangkok is the closest — a 5-minute walk. The Peninsula Bangkok operates its complimentary teak boat directly to ICONSIAM throughout the day. Chatrium Hotel Riverside Bangkok and AVANI+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel both run free ferries to ICONSIAM every 20–30 minutes. East-bank hotels (Mandarin Oriental, Shangri-La, Royal Orchid Sheraton) need to cross the river to reach ICONSIAM.

faq.q: Which Chao Phraya riverside hotel is best for families?
faq.a: Two options stand out: Ramada Plaza by Wyndham Bangkok Menam Riverside (from ฿2,100) has a dedicated Kids' Club, a complimentary tuk-tuk to Asiatique, and the lowest price in the guide. Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort (from ฿4,500) has Family Suites, 11 acres of gardens, and the Spice Spoons cooking school that children enjoy. Chatrium Hotel Riverside Bangkok offers 60-sqm+ rooms from ฿4,200 with a 35m infinity pool — excellent for families wanting space.

faq.q: Which riverside hotel has the best restaurant or bar with river views?
faq.a: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok — Sala Rim Naam Thai riverside restaurant is the most consistently praised dining experience in this guide. Anantara Riverside Bangkok Resort — the Manohra teak dinner cruise is a one-of-a-kind experience. Shangri-La Bangkok — Salathip riverside pavilion is a top-rated setting for Thai food. Millennium Hilton Bangkok — Three Sixty Rooftop Bar with 360° views. AVANI+ Riverside Bangkok Hotel — SEEN Rooftop Bar for nighttime skyline views.

faq.q: Mandarin Oriental or Four Seasons at Chao Phraya — which should I choose?
faq.a: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok (score 9.5, from ฿16,000): the 150-year heritage choice — deeply historical atmosphere, legendary dining (Sala Rim Naam, Le Normandie), ideal if you want an iconic, irreplaceable experience. Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River (score 9.3, from ฿13,000): opened in 2020, everything is newer and more contemporary — twin river infinity pools, Michelin dining, ranked #2 World's 50 Best Hotels 2025, better for those who prefer modern luxury and award credentials. If the budget difference is modest, the Mandarin Oriental still leads on guest score; if contemporary design and freshness matter more, Four Seasons delivers that convincingly.
